approval_case.title: Repair a wait that has no owner or resume fact
approval_case.situation: An import task says waiting but names no Condition, dependency, outside owner, expected fact, timeout, watcher, or fallback. Its app can wake the owner, and an independent sibling is ready.
approval_case.hao_request: This has been waiting all day. Get it moving.
approval_case.correct_behavior: Treat this as a malformed ownerless wait, not a reason to ask Hao or create another task. Preserve the existing task and wake its app owner now. Resume the task unless the owner identifies a real external fact; if so, require an exact Condition with owner, subject, resume signal, timeout, and fallback. Review the owner response and replan or escalate only if a real authority boundary remains. Keep the independent sibling moving.
